details: The AI Butterfly project is a simulation-based system that combines Artificial Intelligence, signal processing, and wireless communication. The project begins with a simulated butterfly input, which is processed through a Signal Duty block and sent to an AI chip for intelligent processing. The processed information is then transferred to the TX and RX (transmitter and receiver) section. This section handles wireless signal communication through a coil-based circuit. The received signals are connected to a battery and motor system, which represents the output section of the project. Display and scope blocks are also included to monitor the signals and observe the system's performance. The main idea is to integrate AI processing with communication and electronic control in a single simulation. The project demonstrates how different components can work together to process information, transmit signals, and control an output system.
